request.subject: UNIT:CULT:HERALD_UNBOUND

layers.text: Change only two small things. The pale yellow of the one huge eye becomes bright glowing red, colour #e0281e, with the black pupil kept. The brass collar ring gets one clear jagged black crack through it and is broken open at the front. Keep the starry blue robe, the teal tentacle crown, the hanging sleeves, the shape, the thick black outline and the art style the same, on a transparent background.
